evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Keep monitored default CLI/MCP versions current with independently published stable releases.
intent.acceptance: Compare actual immutable Go constants with surviving official release publications available at each endpoint.

evidence.opportunity: The frozen eight-tool default-version cohort named by the source workflow.
filters: Compare numeric stable semantic versions, not lexicographic strings or mutable latest tags.
The primary series requires all eight pins to have comparable surviving release evidence.
Partial historical evidence remains a diagnostic; missing pins or publication records are unknown.
Playwright releases mature for three days according to its source-defined installation cooldown.
Deleted releases, historical latest-tag movements, Docker digests, compatibility, research quality and causation are not established.
evidence.collection: Digest-checked immutable constants and normalized exhaustive surviving official publication metadata.

model.architecture: Immutable Go AST pins joined to official release publication history.
model.recommendation: Inspect known release lag and cohort missingness; fewer stale pins is useful progress, not proof of complete upgrade safety.

presentation.label: Known stale default-version pins
presentation.betterLabel: Fewer default pins behind published stable releases

metrics.formula: Count pins below the greatest matured surviving stable release, only when every frozen cohort pin is comparable.
